changes.quote: Minimum Amount Financed $7,500 · Kia Finance America does not finance branded or impaired titles.
changes.note: Eight K504 standard-program rules the record never had. The cosigned-loan cap is the sharp one: 2.00% maximum participation on any cosigned deal regardless of FICO, so a strong-score cosigned contract does not earn the 2.5% the record advertises. Also the $7,500 floor, the branded-title refusal, and the quirk that demos and loaners are entered as used but price at new rates.
